_rules: Every price that appears in a published post must be listed here, or the build hard-fails. Modelled on SIMPLE.MX's invented-price gate: a wrong price in a comparison table destroys the credibility the whole page runs on, and a comparison page is the one place this site makes falsifiable claims about other companies.

`source` must be the vendor's own page — their App Store listing or their pricing page, never a third-party comparison article. Apple's listing is the right source for an iOS comparison because it is the price an iPhone reader would actually pay.
`checked` is the date a human or the daily routine last SAW that figure at that URL. build.py warns past 90 days. Re-read before citing; these change without notice and vary by storefront.
All figures are the US storefront. Never write a price as if it were global — Headspace's own listing says so explicitly.

lullable.note: Not yet on sale. Do not write this as a live price until the App Store listing resolves.
